card.name: Inside drug names, after the first piece
card.fires_on: The second piece of a long drug name that is split into parts, such as 'tar' in zolpidem tartrate or 'bit' in hydrocodone bitartrate. It also fires on the middle of other generic or brand names.

modes.label: Salt names
modes.description: The start of a salt name such as tartrate or bitartrate after the base drug.

modes.label: Second drug in a combination
modes.description: The start of the second drug's name after 'and' in a combination product.
